- TOTAL revenue reached £33.6k TW versus £21.4k LW, a WoW increase of 57.1%.
- TOTAL units came in at 9,130 TW across 770 orders, with units up 33.5% WoW.
- REGENCY CAKESTAND 3 TIER ranked 1 TW with £4,443.21, equal to 13.2% of TW revenue.
- The top five products accounted for 35.9% of TOTAL revenue TW, led by PARTY BUNTING at £2,495.37 and WHITE HANGING HEART T-LIGHT HOLDER at £1,961.04.
- PINK AND LILAC QUILTED THROW added £1,780 WoW to reach £1,825.90 TW, and ENGLISH ROSE DESIGN QUILTED THROW added £1,351 WoW to reach £1,350.97 TW.
- GIANT BLACK SUNGLASSES gained £1,319.10 WoW, while JUMBO BAG STRAWBERRY rose 92.0% WoW and PARTY BUNTING rose 55.9% WoW.
- RED RETROSPOT JUMBO BAG fell £443.20 WoW, the largest TW decline in cash terms.
- WOODEN CROQUET GARDEN SET declined £389.70 WoW (-34.4%) and VINTAGE UNION JACK BUNTING declined £377.20 WoW (-29.8%); MULTI COLOUR SILVER T-LIGHT HOLDER led all products on volume with 823 units TW.
